diagnostics.detail: The argument "ami" is required, but no definition was found.
An input variable with the name "subnet_ids" has not been declared. This variable can be declared with a variable "subnet_ids" {} block.

Adding an attribute name to ignore_changes tells Terraform to ignore future changes to the argument in configuration after the object has been created, retaining the value originally configured. The attribute id is decided by the provider alone and therefore there can never be any configuration value to ignore.
